detail_notes.title: Lapping and connection details
notes: Not more than 50% of bars lapped at one position
Development and lap lengths use Ld, Ld+10Ø and span fractions as drawn
Hook drawing marks 10 × bar diameter; several details are Not to Scale
Beam hoop spacing and anchorage diagrams are preserved as source linework; no bar bending schedule is invented

detail_notes.title: Septic tank and soak pit
notes: Septic tank plan: 4,000 × 1,800 mm overall; compartment dimensions 950, 500 and 1,775 mm are retained in raw observations
Soak pit: Ø900 internal, 2,050 section depth; wall/outer dimensions and layers remain on the sheet
100 mm soil/outlet pipes; 50 mm vent; 100 mm RCC cover; 12 mm plaster; 25 mm manhole cover and 18 inch manhole
Locations, routing and tank section liquid depth are not established in the building/site plan; details are kept separate from positioned building elements

issues.title: Floor / roof naming
issues.detail: Three occupied/storey levels: ground 0, first +3 m, partial second +6 m. +9 m is labelled THIRD FLOOR in section but acts as the upper roof datum; title-block third-floor area is a dash.

issues.title: Overall length chain
issues.detail: Written overall 11,675 mm; 4,140 + 3,575 + 3,600 + 355 = 11,670 mm. Grid dimensions are retained without silently adding 5 mm.

issues.title: Coverage ratio
issues.detail: Stated GCR 47.90%; stated plinth / land computes 46.860%. FAR computes 1.065745 versus stated 1.065.

issues.title: Opening schedule versus plans
issues.detail: W1 quantity is a dash; W2 schedule says 5 and W3 says 1, while plan tags differ. SD appears on first-floor plan but has no schedule row. Window widths traced in the plan can differ from the schedule (notably W3). Keep scheduled and traced values separately.

issues.title: Beam and footing detail conflicts
issues.detail: STRAP layout 355 × 600 differs from 300 × 500 detail; EF2 plan has an EF1 typical section; F1 thickness D is not numeric; MB2 longitudinal bar labels differ from section. Layout sizes drive only the display envelope.

issues.title: Floor build-up disagreement
issues.detail: Section specifies 25 mm finish + 75 mm PCC + 200 mm boulder. Footing detail specifies 50 mm finish, 100 mm sand and stone soling. Neither is overwritten.

issues.title: Display assumptions
issues.detail: 17 equal stair risers close 3 m rather than exact 176 mm; railing height 1 m, vent sill 1.10 m, SD height 2.134 m and subsurface beam elevations are provisional. Roof beam applicability and traced slab contours require confirmation.

issues.title: Unpositioned services and drawing-only details
issues.detail: No surveyed site boundaries, tank position, service routing, MEP layouts, reinforcement cut lengths or complete construction specifications are inferred. All source diagrams remain in the sheet viewer and raw extraction.

issues.title: Raw layer names are not object identities
issues.detail: The PDF retains CAD layer labels but no original DWG solids, BIM object identities, authoring constraints or model history. A WALL layer also contains sheet borders and symbols; semantic classification is a reviewed overlay.

editing.mode: Conversational changes through the AI assistant, then GitHub commit/build; no live AI endpoint or automated interpretation is claimed.
editing.rule: Preserve observed source records. Record design changes and assumptions separately with provenance. Rebuild the 2D/3D/table projections from this one model.
